dedupe_keys.name: japan civil aviation and airport statistics mlit civil aviation bureau

description: The Civil Aviation Bureau of Japan's Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism publishes a page of aviation statistics and data that lists aviation safety information, the number of aircraft handled by air traffic control, airport management status, a map of national airport locations, airport income and expenditure, management information of airport operators and the status of international routes. The figures come from the bureau's own administration of airports and air traffic control. Coverage is national (Japan). The material is published as web pages and downloadable files on the MLIT site, free to read; no licence is stated on the page. Caveats: the items are spread over separate pages with different formats and update cycles, and most documents are in Japanese. The statistics support capacity planning of airports and airspace, demand inputs to network flow models and context for airport financial resilience studies. They complement the MLIT port statistics and the national land numerical information road and port layers catalogued here.
